hints.title: Check Local Valley and Peak Conditions
hints.text: An element increases if strictly smaller than both neighbors, and decreases if strictly greater than both.

hints.title: Apply Updates Simultaneously
hints.text: Calculate changes based strictly on the snapshot at the beginning of each day to prevent cascading changes within the day.

hints.title: Iterate Until Convergence
hints.text: Repeat the transformation rounds until a day passes with zero changes.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: R: number of simulation rounds until stability
complexity.whyNaiveFails: In-place immediate updates corrupt neighbor checks for adjacent cells within the same round.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Simulating synchronized rounds takes linear time per step and O(N) space for next-day copy.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should preserve boundary elements untouched and terminate when no change occurs.
complexity.notes: Elements at index 0 and n - 1 never change.
